The GitHub mirror is older; the bundled JavaScript comes from the official
Telegram delivery URL above, not from that mirror revision.

Pushok serves this pinned asset from its own origin so client startup does not
require a second connection to telegram.org. No build-time download is needed.
To update: review the current official SDK, keep its license, compute SHA-256,
rename the content-addressed asset, update the loader and checksum test, and run
the Mini App browser tests with external requests blocked. Server-side signed
initData validation remains mandatory and unchanged.
